saints.name: St. Damasus I
saints.title: Pope
saints.shortBlurb: The pope who set Jerome to work on the Latin Bible and adorned the tombs of the martyrs in the Roman catacombs…
biography: Damasus was born about 305 and served as a Roman deacon before his election as pope in 366. He defended the faith against Arianism and the errors of Apollinaris, upheld the primacy of the Roman See, and confirmed the teaching of the Council of Constantinople of 381.

He set his secretary St. Jerome to the revision of the Latin Scriptures that led in time to the Vulgate, and he sought out, restored, and adorned with verse inscriptions the graves of the martyrs in the catacombs. He died in 384.
saints.knownFor: Commissioning the Vulgate and honoring the martyrs of the catacombs.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 11 December
